name: BENZOCAINE 200 MG ORAL SOLUTION WITH APPLICATOR 1 PIECE
description: Topical solution to relieve pain from mouth ulcers, canker sores, abrasions, or irritation from dentures or braces, thanks to its anesthetic action, which forms a protective film over the lesion. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
